title: Re-port canonical Fourfold projection identity consolidation onto current main
primary_claim: The reviewed Fourfold projection-identity consolidation from stale PR #244 is selectively re-ported onto current main without carrying its obsolete branch ancestry: projection_verifier reuses FOURFOLD_PLANES and CrossPlaneBinding.semantic_key, and the focused regression test is retained byte-identically.

containment.statement: The production file and focused regression are Git-blob-identical to the reviewed versions in PR #244; only the Work-Packet metadata is renewed for the current main base. This retains the old packet's useful evidence while discarding stale branch ancestry.

baseline_review.finding: Current main still duplicates the constitutional four-plane tuple in two verifier buckets and reconstructs a five-field cross-plane key even though CrossPlaneBinding.semantic_key already owns six-field semantic identity including source_revision.
baseline_review.gardener_decision: selective port, not merge: reuse the exact reviewed production/test blobs from #244 and do not import unrelated historical commits

acceptance: projection verifier uses FOURFOLD_PLANES for all per-plane buckets
snapshot-side cross-plane identity is taken from CrossPlaneBinding.semantic_key
Forest-side binding keys include the exact Fourfold source revision and match the six-field semantic identity shape
the duplicate _binding_key helper and unused Iterable import are absent
the focused architecture test prevents a second four-plane tuple or binding-key authority from regrowing
the reference fixture remains deterministic and an exact Forest projection
